title: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang Resigns: What's Actually Confirmed #Shorts
description:
Nvidia's CEO Jensen Huang has resigned after 33 years. Here is only what is confirmed - and what is still just an allegation.

What is confirmed (as of 14 Nov 2026):
- 12 Nov: Nvidia announced Jensen Huang's immediate resignation as president, CEO and board member.
- CFO Colette Kress is interim CEO; Harvey C. Jones is board chair.
- 8 Nov: Huang told employees he had been unfaithful to his wife.
- Nvidia's board is investigating reports that he was targeted by a foreign intelligence effort. These are allegations; the board said it has no reason to believe national security was compromised.
